```{r global_options, include=FALSE}
set.seed(97310)
```

*entropart* is being superseded by the [*divent*](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/) package.
It will be maintained, i.e. bugs will be corrected and updates required by CRAN will be made, but no new development is expected.

# General changes

Object names follow the Pascal-case style in *entropart*, e.g.
`DivPart()`.
*divent* follows the recommendations of the tidyverse, e.g. snake-case names with prefixes, e.g. `div_part()`.

Functions' values are often lists in *entropart*, vs. tibbles in *divent*, where argument `as_numeric = TRUE` allows obtaining numeric outputs from many functions.

Abundance or probability data are named vectors in *entropart*, declared as `AbdVector` or `ProbaVector` objects by the `as.AbdVector()` or `as.ProbaVector()`function.
In *divent*, numeric vectors are used directly or converted to tibbles of class `abundances` or `probabilities` by functions `as_abundances()` or `as_probabilities()`.

The following table shows the correspondence between *entropart* and *divent* functions.

# Function names

| **entropart** | **divent** |
|---------------------------------|---------------------------------------|
| [`AbdFreqCount()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/AbdFreqCount.html): Abundance Frequency Count of a Community | [`abd_freq_count()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/abd_freq_count.html) |
| [`AllenH()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/AllenH.html): Phylogenetic Entropy of a Community | [`ent_allen()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/ent_allen.html) |
| [`CommunityProfile()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/CommunityProfile.html): Diversity Profile of a Community. Argument \`FUN\` defines the diversity function. | \- [`profile_hill()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/profile_hill.html) : Taxonomic Diversity Profile of a Community<br>- [`profile_phylo()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/profile_phylo.html): Phylogenetic Diversity Profile of a Community<br> - [`profile_similarity()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/profile_similarity.html): Similarity-Based Diversity Profile of a Community |
| [`Coverage()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Coverage.html): Sample coverage of a community | [`coverage()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/coverage.html) |
| [`DivAC()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Accumulation.html): Diversity accumulation. | [`accum_hill()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/accum_hill.html) |
| [`Diversity()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Diversity.html) / [`bcDiversity()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Diversity.html): Hill number of a community | [`div_hill()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/div_hill.html) |
| [`DivPart()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/DivPart.html): Diversity Partition of a metacommunity | [`div_part()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/div_part.html) |
| [`Dqz()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Dqz.html) / [`bcDqz()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Dqz.html): Similarity-based diversity of a community | [`div_similarity()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/div_similarity.html) |
| [`Enq()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Enq.html): Grassberger's expectation of $n^q$ | [`e_n_q()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/e_n_q.html) |
| [`EntAC()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Accumulation.html): Entropy accumulation. | [`accum_tsallis()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/accum_hill.html) |
| [`expq()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/expq.html): Exponential of order q | [`exp_q()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/exp_q.html) |
| [`GenSimpson()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/GenSimpson.html) / [`bcGenSimpson()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/GenSimpson.html): Generalized Simpson's Entropy | [`ent_gen_simpson()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/ent_gen_simpson.html) |
| [`GenSimpsonD()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/GenSimpson.html) / [`bcGenSimpsonD()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/GenSimpson.html): Generalized Simpson's Diversity | [`div_gen_simpson()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/div_gen_simpson.html) |
| [`Hqz()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Hqz.html) / [`bcHqz()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Hqz.html): Similarity-based entropy of a community | [`ent_similarity()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/ent_similarity.html) |
| [`Hurlbert()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Hurlbert.html) / [`bcHurlbert()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Hurlbert.html): Hurlbert's Entropy | [`ent_hurlbert()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/div_hurlbert.html) |
| [`HurlbertD()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Hurlbert.html) / [`bcHurlbertD()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Hurlbert.html): Hurlbert's Explicit Diversity | [`div_hurlbert()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/div_hurlbert.html) |
| [`lnq()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/lnq.html): Logarithm of order q | [`ln_q()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/ln_q.html) |
| [`MetaCommunity()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/MetaCommunity.html): Metacommunity class | [`metacommunity()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/metacommunity.html): Aggregate communities into a metacommunity |
| [`PDFD()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/PDFD.html): Phylogenetic Diversity / Functional Diversity of a Community | [`div_pd()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/div_pd.html) |
| [`PhyloDiversity()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/PhyloDiversity.html) / [`bcPhyloDiversity()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/PhyloDiversity.html): Phylogenetic Diversity of a Community | [`div_phylo()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/div_phylo.html) |
| [`PhyloEntropy()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/PhyloEntropy.html) / [`bcPhyloEntropy()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/PhyloEntropy.html): Phylogenetic Entropy of a community | [`ent_phylo()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/ent_phylo.html) |
| [`RAClnorm()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/RAC.html) / [`RACgeom()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/RAC.html) / [`RAClseries()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/RAC.html) / [`RACbstick()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/RAC.html): Fit Distributions to Well-Known Rank Abundance Curves. | [`fit_rac()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/fit_rac.html) |
| [`Rao()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Rao.html) / [`bcRao()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Rao.html): Rao's Quadratic Entropy of a Community | [`ent_rao()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/ent_rao.html) |
| [`rCommunity()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/rCommunity.html): Random Communities | [`rcommunity()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/rcommunity.html) |
| [`Richness()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Richness.html) / [`bcRichness()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Richness.html): Number of species of a community | [`div_richness()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/div_richness.html) |
| [`Shannon()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Shannon.html) / [`bcShannon()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Shannon.html): Shannon entropy of a community | [`ent_shannon()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/ent_shannon.html) |
| [`Simpson()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Simpson.html) / [`bcSimpson()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Simpson.html): Simpson entropy of a community | [`ent_simpson()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/ent_simpson.html) |
| [`Tsallis()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Tsallis.html) / [`bcTsallis()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/entropart/reference/Tsallis.html): Tsallis (HCDT) Entropy of a community | [`ent_tsallis()`](https://ericmarcon.github.io/divent/reference/ent_tsallis.html) |

# Example

```{r}
library("entropart")
library("divent")
# Random community, lognormal, 10 individuals, 3 species 
entropart::rCommunity(
  n = 1,
  size = 10, 
  S = 3, 
  Distribution = "lnorm"
)
# Equivalent to
divent::rcommunity(
  n = 1, 
  size = 10, 
  species_number = 3, 
  distribution = "lnorm"
)
# use as.numeric() to produce a vector rather than a tibble
divent::rcommunity(
  n = 1, 
  size = 10, 
  species_number = 3, 
  distribution = "lnorm"
) |>
  as.numeric()
```
